policy: Review every closed candidate set. Select only when ASV wording or an explicit mapped textual note distinguishes a reading; otherwise mark underdetermined and retain the base fallback. The base candidate is the qere, which is what MACULA Hebrew projects; the alternative is the ketiv written in the Leningrad Codex.

decisions.evidence: ASV's spelling 'Shahazumah' distinguishes the ketiv reading ושחצומה, whose ו supports the 'u' vowel, from the qere/base ושחצימה.

ASV 'the goings out thereof were at the sea' permits both verbal readings and does not distinguish their Hebrew forms; the two notes are alternative_rendering notes and therefore do not decide this textual unit. The documented qere/base remains the fallback.
